title: The $1.7 Trillion Morning That Left OpenAI Behind

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Late Thursday morning, November nineteenth. Wall Street.
lines.shot_hint: trading floor mid-action, screens flicker, place tag Nasdaq / Nov 19, 2026

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: A brand new stock is about to trade for the very first time.
lines.shot_hint: ticker board, blank row ANT blinking

lines.speaker: TRADER
lines.text: Where's it opening?
lines.shot_hint: trader close-up, headset; tag THE TRADER

lines.speaker: SECOND TRADER
lines.text: A hundred and eleven fifty.
lines.shot_hint: second trader, screen flips to $111.50 in gold

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The company is Anthropic. In 2021, it was a handful of people who had just quit OpenAI.
lines.shot_hint: Anthropic name on the board -> quick flash of an office door closing (2021)

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Seven of its founders have already sold shares. About two hundred and eighty million dollars each.
lines.shot_hint: seven chairs / seven silhouettes, counter $280M gold

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Before a single share traded.
lines.shot_hint: typed card

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: And the company they walked out of? Still waiting for its turn.
lines.shot_hint: OpenAI-style HQ at night, one lit window, empty ticker slot

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: So who really got rich that morning? And who paid for it?
lines.shot_hint: typed card

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Rewind to 2021.
lines.shot_hint: calendar flips back to 2021

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: OpenAI is the hottest name in artificial intelligence. Then a group of its own people walks out.
lines.shot_hint: office at night, a line of silhouettes leaving with boxes

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Among them, siblings Dario and Daniela Amodei. Their new company is called Anthropic.
lines.shot_hint: two characters, tags DARIO AMODEI / co-founder, DANIELA AMODEI / co-founder

lines.speaker: ANALYST
lines.text: They left OpenAI to compete with OpenAI?
lines.shot_hint: analyst close-up; tag THE ANALYST

lines.speaker: INVESTOR
lines.text: Bold.
lines.shot_hint: investor sips coffee; tag THE INVESTOR

lines.speaker: ANALYST
lines.text: Or very expensive.
lines.shot_hint: analyst deadpan

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Late 2022, OpenAI launches ChatGPT. Within two months, an estimated hundred million people are using it.
lines.shot_hint: phones lighting up across a city, user counter

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Anthropic takes the quieter road. It sells its AI mostly to businesses.
lines.shot_hint: office towers, contracts sliding across desks

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Remember that choice. It is about to be worth a fortune.
lines.shot_hint: contract signed, gold glint; cliffhanger

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: March 2026. OpenAI shuts down Sora, its viral video app. Six months after launch.
lines.shot_hint: phone app icon greys out, SHUT DOWN gold stamp

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: A billion-dollar deal with Disney goes with it. Reports say no money ever changed hands.
lines.shot_hint: deal folder closes, counter drains to 0 in orange

lines.speaker: CLERK
lines.text: Disney is on the line.
lines.shot_hint: clerk holding phone; tag THE CLERK

lines.speaker: MANAGER
lines.text: Tell them it was a great six months.
lines.shot_hint: manager rubs temples; tag THE MANAGER

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Then the summer numbers arrive. The Wall Street Journal reports Anthropic took in eleven point six billion dollars in the second quarter.
lines.shot_hint: bar chart: Anthropic bar rises

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: OpenAI? Six point seven billion. They count revenue differently. Still, the headlines called it a first.
lines.shot_hint: second bar shorter; small label COUNTED DIFFERENTLY; newspaper spins in

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The company that walked out had passed the company it left.
lines.shot_hint: typed card

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: In September, Sam Altman said OpenAI would not go public in 2026.
lines.shot_hint: interview set, Altman character; tag SAM ALTMAN / CEO, OpenAI

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Anthropic wasn't going to wait.
lines.shot_hint: calendar page tears to November; cliffhanger

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Here's how an IPO morning really works. In order.
lines.shot_hint: a line of figures forms: banks, big investors, founders, public last

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: First, the banks set a price. On Wednesday night, eighty-three dollars a share. Above the range they planned.
lines.shot_hint: price tag slides from $70-78 up to $83

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Then they sell the shares. Mostly to a list of big investors.
lines.shot_hint: a gold-edged list, names blurred, shares handed down the list

lines.speaker: SAVER
lines.text: Can I buy some at eighty-three?
lines.shot_hint: saver at a desk counter; tag THE SAVER

lines.speaker: BANKER
lines.text: Are you on the list?
lines.shot_hint: banker looks over glasses; tag THE BANKER

lines.speaker: SAVER
lines.text: What list?
lines.shot_hint: saver blinks, list rolls shut

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Nine hundred and eighty million shares. More than eighty billion dollars. The biggest IPO on record.
lines.shot_hint: share stacks fill a vault, $81B counter

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Inside that sale, the seven co-founders. Just over three million shares each.
lines.shot_hint: seven share certificates on a table

lines.speaker: BANKER
lines.text: Seven signatures.
lines.shot_hint: pen signs, gold stamp

lines.speaker: CLERK
lines.text: Seven fortunes.
lines.shot_hint: clerk stacks the signed pages

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Nearly two billion dollars together. All before the public could buy a single share.
lines.shot_hint: bell still silent, clock hand ticking to opening; cliffhanger

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Then the opening bell rings. And here's what most people miss.
lines.shot_hint: bell rings, music drops

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Anthropic sold at eighty-three. The stock opened at a hundred and eleven fifty.
lines.shot_hint: two price tags side by side, gap glowing gold

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: That jump didn't go to Anthropic. It went to whoever got shares at eighty-three.
lines.shot_hint: typed card

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: By the closing bell, those shares were worth about fourteen billion dollars more. In one day.
lines.shot_hint: the list glows, counter $14B (calculation, see sources)

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The next day, the stock falls about nine percent. To around eighty-five dollars.
lines.shot_hint: orange down arrow on the ticker

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Anyone who bought at the opening price was down almost a quarter.
lines.shot_hint: pie of a $111.50 share loses a quarter slice in orange

lines.speaker: TRADER
lines.text: I bought the open.
lines.shot_hint: trader slumps

lines.speaker: SECOND TRADER
lines.text: Everybody bought the open.
lines.shot_hint: pan across a row of slumped traders

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: And one buyer never gets a choice. Index funds.
lines.shot_hint: conveyor of fund boxes, each auto-grabbing a share

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Total stock market funds add giants like this within days. Morningstar estimates around eight dollars of every ten thousand.
lines.shot_hint: fund screen: tiny gold sliver of 10,000

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: But the S&P 500 says no. Not until a full year of trading. And real profits.
lines.shot_hint: typed card

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: And OpenAI? It reportedly filed in secret in June. It's aiming for 2027.
lines.shot_hint: sealed envelope CONFIDENTIAL, calendar 2027

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Back to that Thursday morning. A hundred and eleven fifty.
lines.shot_hint: callback: the same trading floor, same ticker

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Seven people who once walked out of OpenAI walked away with nearly two billion dollars.
lines.shot_hint: seven silhouettes walk out of frame

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Their old company is still waiting at the door.
lines.shot_hint: OpenAI-style HQ door at night, light on

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: When OpenAI finally rings its bell, who gets paid first this time?
lines.shot_hint: final typed question card

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: OpenAI's bell is coming. When it rings, we'll follow the money again. Subscribe, so you're on our list.
lines.shot_hint: callback to 'the list': Nasdaq tower keeps moving, subscribe button slides in, cursor clicks -> SUBSCRIBED (owner: no logo outro)
